regions.name: Manitou Beach / Devils Lake
regions.description: Heart of the Irish Hills. Devils Lake and Round Lake total over 1,800 acres — the largest connected lake system in Lenawee County. Year-round community with yacht club, golf course, and strong local roots.
regions.commute: Jackson 25 min, Ann Arbor 45 min, Detroit 90 min

regions.name: Clark Lake
regions.description: Clark Lake is one of the most popular all-sports lakes in Jackson County — 1,000+ acres, clear water, busy summer community. Brooklyn village is a mile away with shops and restaurants.
highlights: Largest all-sports lake in Jackson County

regions.name: Brooklyn & Lake Columbia
regions.description: Lake Columbia is the largest private lake in Michigan — 840 acres, gated community, no public access. Brooklyn village has great restaurants and is 1 mile from the lake.

regions.name: Onsted & Hayes State Park
regions.description: W.J. Hayes State Park and Wamplers Lake — one of the most popular recreation lakes in southern Michigan. Round Lake connects for peaceful fishing.
highlights: Hayes State Park with beach & camping

regions.name: Cambridge & US-12 Corridor
regions.description: A string of lakes along the scenic US-12 through Cambridge Township — Sand Lake, Evans Lake, Allen Lake, and the planned community of Loch Erin.

regions.name: Jerome & Somerset
regions.description: Lake LeAnn is a premier private lake community — controlled access, well-maintained, quiet. Farwell Lake and Round Lake round out this western cluster near the Hillsdale County line.

regions.name: Southern Lakes
regions.description: Vineyard Lake, Iron Lake, and Posey Lake — the southern edge of Holly's territory. More affordable lakefront, quieter communities, great for first-time lake buyers.
highlights: Most affordable lakefront in the territory

regions.name: Grass Lake & Michigan Center
regions.description: Northern edge of Holly's territory. The Grass Lake chain and Wolf Lake chain offer more casual lake living near I-94 corridor.

regions.name: Tecumseh & Eastern Lenawee
regions.description: No lakes here — but historic homes, walkable downtown Tecumseh, strong local economy, and rural acreage. Great for buyers who want country living without a lake price tag.

propertyTypes.lakefront: Direct waterfront with private shoreline and usually a dock
propertyTypes.lake-access: Deeded access to the lake, typically a short walk or shared beach — more affordable than lakefront
propertyTypes.rural: Country properties with land, no lake
propertyTypes.farm: Agricultural or hobby farm properties, often with barns and outbuildings
propertyTypes.cottage: Smaller seasonal or year-round lake properties
propertyTypes.historic: Architecturally significant or period homes, mostly in Tecumseh

buyingFAQ.q: What's the difference between lakefront and lake access?
buyingFAQ.a: Lakefront means your property directly touches the water — you own the shoreline and typically have a dock. Lake access means you have a legal right to use the lake (deeded access, shared beach, or association access) but your property doesn't touch the water. Lake access properties are usually 30-60% cheaper.

buyingFAQ.q: Do I need a special inspection for lake property?
buyingFAQ.a: Yes — Holly always recommends a lake-specific inspection that covers the seawall condition, dock structure, depth and clarity, and any restrictions on shoreline modification. Septic systems are also critical — most lake properties use septic, not municipal sewer.
An all-sports lake allows motorized boats including jet skis. No-wake or quiet lakes limit motor speed, which is great for kayaking and fishing but not for tubing or waterskiing.

buyingFAQ.q: Are there HOA fees on lakes like Lake Columbia?
buyingFAQ.a: Private lakes like Lake Columbia have homeowner associations with annual dues — usually $500–$2,000/year — that maintain roads, common areas, and lake quality. Public lakes like Devils Lake have no HOA.

Lakefront inventory is always tight in the Irish Hills. Good properties in the $300K–$500K range move fast — sometimes within days. Holly can set you up with real-time alerts and preview pre-list properties she hears about through her network.
